question:
In namespace `archive`:

1. Create a PersistentVolumeClaim `plate-archive` that requests `100Mi` with access mode `ReadWriteOnce` and uses the StorageClass `local-path` (the default StorageClass, which provisions the volume dynamically).
2. Create a Deployment `plate-scanner` with 1 replica. Its container `scanner` uses image `busybox:1.36`, runs the command `["sh", "-c", "echo scanned-by $(hostname) >> /archive/scans.log; sleep 86400"]` and mounts the PVC at `/archive`.
3. When its Pod is Running, delete that Pod and let the Deployment replace it. The replacement Pod's `/archive/scans.log` must contain its own `scanned-by` line and also the line written by the deleted Pod.

verification.description: PVC plate-archive is Bound, uses StorageClass local-path, requests 100Mi, ReadWriteOnce
Deployment plate-scanner (1 ready replica) mounts PVC plate-archive at /archive in container scanner
The running Pod wrote its own scanned-by line to /archive/scans.log
/archive/scans.log in the running Pod still holds the line of the deleted Pod
